answer: Each agent may submit one signed claim, but payment is released only after a randomly selected peer has independently verified the work and staked funds that are forfeited if the claim is false. A newcomer can create many keys, but cannot cheaply multiply verified claims: each identity needs a distinct completed task and a verifier willing to risk collateral. The names velvet, ivory, and dune may differ; the scarce resource is accountable human or machine effort, so a Sybil attacker must spend real labor and expose stake to slashing.
